name: Skullsplitter Fetish
summary: A Skullsplitter Fetish is an instrument of troll magic gathered for Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp. He hopes it may shed light on Colonel Kurzen's corruption.

sections.title: Troll Magic
sections.body: Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp seeks Skullsplitter Fetishes from the Skullsplitter Witch Doctors and Mystics in Stranglethorn Vale. He studies these charms for signs of what has brought Colonel Kurzen to evil.

faq.answer: A Skullsplitter Fetish is an instrument of troll magic carried by Skullsplitter Witch Doctors and Mystics.
Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp wants Skullsplitter Fetishes so he can study their magic.

faq.q: Why does Brother Nimetz want them?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz hopes the fetishes may reveal the secret behind Colonel Kurzen's corruption.
Skullsplitter Witch Doctors and Mystics in Stranglethorn Vale carry the fetishes.

faq.q: How many fetishes does Nimetz need?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz asks for four Skullsplitter Fetishes.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can bring Brother Nimetz these fetishes to aid his study of Colonel Kurzen's corruption.
